section: Why the indices are the degrees
context: The actions are transitive, so the [[algebra-groups/orbit-stabilizer-theorem|orbit–stabilizer theorem]] identifies each coset space with the relevant point set. Each action is at least doubly transitive, hence primitive, and its point stabilizer is maximal. Composing the last two embeddings also gives a copy of \(M_{22}\) in \(M_{24}\) of index \(23\cdot24=552\).
